treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Estonia and the Portuguese Republic for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2003)
eif_quote: Estonia MoF table (No. | Jurisdiction | Initialled | Signed | Ratified | In force from | Effective from | MLI effective from): 49. | Portugal | 03.07.1998 + changes through correspondence | 13.05.2003 | 19.05.2004 ( est/eng ) | 23.07.2004 | 01.01.2005 |
source_title: EE-PT Convention 2003 with Protocol (Riigi Teataja, est/eng)

rates.quote: the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.
the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Estonia reserved MLI Art. 35(7)(a) and has not notified completion for Portugal, so the MLI PPT has no effect. Treaty Art. 27 'Limitation of Benefits' is an abuse rule requiring agreement of both competent authorities: "The provisions of this Convention shall not be construed as obliging a Contracting State to grant the benefits under this Convention to any person ... if, according to the competent authorities of both Contracting States, the receipt of those benefits will constitute an abuse of the general principles of the Convention."

notes: Single 10% dividend rate (no participation tier). Interest exempt at source for Government (incl. subdivisions/local authorities), Central Bank, wholly-owned financial institutions, government-guaranteed loans (Art. 11(3)). Protocol: dividends include associação em participação profits; Art. 27 abuse rule (not modelled as PPT). Signature date: MoF table and text 13.05.2003 (PT MLI list shows 12.05.2003).
